# NSP Link Reference Submodule

This submodule looks up existing link references for a Network Security Perimeter (`Microsoft.Network/networkSecurityPerimeters/linkReferences`).

The service creates the remote counterpart when a link is established. API
2025-05-01 exposes GET and DELETE, but no PUT lifecycle. This submodule never
creates, updates or deletes a link reference. The reference must already exist;
a missing object fails the lookup.

Existing main-sourced `azapi_resource.this` bindings are forgotten with a
module-owned `removed` block (`destroy = false`). The remote object is not deleted.
This is not a replacement owner: lifecycle remains with the link/service.
Telemetry retains its separate opt-out and subscription deployment requirements.

Optional canonical `lock` and `role_assignments` manage extensions at the
existing reference scope, not the reference lifecycle. Direct, separately named
AzAPI resources create/delete only locks and explicitly requested assignments;
the interfaces utility supplies canonical configuration, not lifecycle ownership.
`remote_perimeter_extensions` inherits this submodule's lock by default;
`lock_inheritance_enabled = false` disables the remote lock even with an
override. Remote RBAC defaults empty.

Remote extension management requires a non-null `remote_perimeter_resource_id`;
it may come from another module and remain unknown during planning. Extension
presence, assignment keys and role selectors must be plan-known. Terraform
retains the remote scope dependency without requiring a separate deployment.
Its identity must match `properties.remotePerimeterResourceId` returned by GET.
No remote ID is inferred from an update-sensitive output. Without remote
extensions, omit that ID and explicitly disable inheritance when applying a
reference lock. The reference remains GET-only and is never deleted on teardown.
If the link that produces the reference is created in the same apply, pass
its output through the relevant reference input so the GET waits for that link;
an unknown remote perimeter ID alone does not establish that service dependency.

Direct `authorization_locks` and `authorization_role_assignments` control fields
apply uniformly to the distinct reference and remote extension blocks.
`authorization_role_definitions` controls stable role lookups. This module owns
the stable tested defaults for its direct extensions even though the reference
itself is data-only. Retry/timeouts apply to extensions, not unsupported GET
data-source arguments.

## Optional Inputs

The following input variables are optional (have default values):

### <a name="input_enable_telemetry"></a> [enable\_telemetry](#input\_enable\_telemetry)

Description: This variable controls whether or not telemetry is enabled for the module.  
For more information see <https://aka.ms/avm/telemetryinfo>.  
If it is set to false, then no telemetry will be collected.

Type: `bool`

Default: `true`

### <a name="input_ignore_body_changes"></a> [ignore\_body\_changes](#input\_ignore\_body\_changes)

Description: Body-relative dot-notation paths: `authorization_locks` for reference and remote locks; `authorization_role_assignments` for reference and remote RBAC. Same ARM-kind resources share one field, applied uniformly to both scopes. Ignored configuration is not sent to Azure until removed; changes take effect after apply. No ignore interface is applied to the GET-only reference.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    authorization_locks            = optional(list(string), [])
    authorization_role_assignments = optional(list(string), [])
  })
```

Default: `{}`

### <a name="input_location"></a> [location](#input\_location)

Description: The Azure region for this module's resources or telemetry deployment.

Type: `string`

Default: `null`

### <a name="input_lock"></a> [lock](#input\_lock)

Description: Controls the Resource Lock configuration for this resource. The following properties can be specified:

- `kind` - (Required) The type of lock. Possible values are `\"CanNotDelete\"` and `\"ReadOnly\"`.
- `name` - (Optional) The name of the lock. If not specified, a name will be generated based on the `kind` value. Changing this forces the creation of a new resource.
- `notes` - (Optional) Notes about the lock. This value maps to `Microsoft.Authorization/locks.properties.notes`.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    kind  = string
    name  = optional(string, null)
    notes = optional(string, null)
  })
```

Default: `null`

### <a name="input_remote_perimeter_extensions"></a> [remote\_perimeter\_extensions](#input\_remote\_perimeter\_extensions)

Description: Extensions only on remote\_perimeter\_resource\_id. `lock_inheritance_enabled` defaults true: explicit `lock` overrides the owning module lock; false disables the lock even with an override. `role_assignments` uses canonical RBAC fields and defaults empty (no automatic permissions). The reference itself stays GET-only.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    lock_inheritance_enabled = optional(bool, true)
    lock = optional(object({
      kind  = string
      name  = optional(string, null)
      notes = optional(string, null)
    }))
    role_assignments = optional(map(object({
      name                                   = optional(string, null)
      role_definition_id_or_name             = string
      principal_id                           = string
      description                            = optional(string, null)
      skip_service_principal_aad_check       = optional(bool, false)
      condition                              = optional(string, null)
      condition_version                      = optional(string, null)
      delegated_managed_identity_resource_id = optional(string, null)
      principal_type                         = optional(string, null)
    })), {})
  })
```

Default: `{}`

### <a name="input_remote_perimeter_resource_id"></a> [remote\_perimeter\_resource\_id](#input\_remote\_perimeter\_resource\_id)

Description: Known ARM ID of the externally owned remote perimeter, required when managing remote extensions. Checked against the GET-only reference before writes; never derived from an update-sensitive output.

Type: `string`

Default: `null`

### <a name="input_resource_types"></a> [resource\_types](#input\_resource\_types)

Description: AzAPI types and tested API defaults owned here: `network_network_security_perimeters_link_references` for the GET-only reference; `authorization_locks` for reference and remote locks; `authorization_role_assignments` for reference and remote RBAC; `authorization_role_definitions` for stable-scope lookups. Same ARM-kind resources share a uniform override.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    network_network_security_perimeters_link_references = optional(string, "Microsoft.Network/networkSecurityPerimeters/linkReferences@2025-05-01")
    authorization_locks                                 = optional(string, "Microsoft.Authorization/locks@2020-05-01")
    authorization_role_assignments                      = optional(string, "Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments@2022-04-01")
    authorization_role_definitions                      = optional(string, "Microsoft.Authorization/roleDefinitions@2022-04-01")
  })
```

Default: `{}`

### <a name="input_retry"></a> [retry](#input\_retry)

Description: Extension retry controls: error\_message\_regex defaults to ScopeLocked, PrincipalNotFound and LinkedAuthorizationFailed; interval\_seconds and max\_interval\_seconds default to 15 and 60. Patterns can be replaced, or set retry to null for provider defaults. Retries do not grant missing permissions. The GET-only reference data source does not support this resource argument.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    error_message_regex  = optional(list(string), ["ScopeLocked", "PrincipalNotFound", "LinkedAuthorizationFailed"])
    interval_seconds     = optional(number, 15)
    max_interval_seconds = optional(number, 60)
  })
```

Default: `{}`

### <a name="input_role_assignments"></a> [role\_assignments](#input\_role\_assignments)

Description: A map of role assignments to create on the existing NSP link reference. The map key is deliberately arbitrary to avoid issues where map keys maybe unknown at plan time.

- `name` - (Optional) The name of the role assignment. If not set, a random UUID will be generated. Changing this forces the creation of a new resource.
- `role_definition_id_or_name` - The ID or name of the role definition to assign to the principal.
- `principal_id` - The ID of the principal to assign the role to.
- `description` - (Optional) The description of the role assignment.
- `skip_service_principal_aad_check` - (Optional) If set to true, skips the Azure Active Directory check for the service principal in the tenant. Defaults to false.
- `condition` - (Optional) The condition which will be used to scope the role assignment.
- `condition_version` - (Optional) The version of the condition syntax. Leave as `null` if you are not using a condition, if you are then valid values are '2.0'.
- `delegated_managed_identity_resource_id` - (Optional) The delegated Azure Resource Id which contains a Managed Identity. Changing this forces a new resource to be created. This field is only used in cross-tenant scenario.
- `principal_type` - (Optional) The type of the `principal_id`. Possible values are `User`, `Group` and `ServicePrincipal`. It is necessary to explicitly set this attribute when creating role assignments if the principal creating the assignment is constrained by ABAC rules that filters on the PrincipalType attribute.

> Note: only set `skip_service_principal_aad_check` to true if you are assigning a role to a service principal.

Type:

```hcl
map(object({
    name                                   = optional(string, null)
    role_definition_id_or_name             = string
    principal_id                           = string
    description                            = optional(string, null)
    skip_service_principal_aad_check       = optional(bool, false)
    condition                              = optional(string, null)
    condition_version                      = optional(string, null)
    delegated_managed_identity_resource_id = optional(string, null)
    principal_type                         = optional(string, null)
  }))
```

Default: `{}`

### <a name="input_timeouts"></a> [timeouts](#input\_timeouts)

Description: Extension Go-duration timeouts: create, read, update, delete. The GET-only reference data source has no resource timeouts block.

Type:

```hcl
object({

  })
```

Default: `null`
